profile.businessType: The Company provides administrative and management services for industrial wastes, hazardous wastes, waste water treatment, waste treatment for sustainable fuel and raw materials.
profile.address: NO. 488 SOILADPRAO 130 (MAHATTHAI 2) KLONGCHAN SUB-DISTRICT, BANGKAPI DISTRICT Bangkok 10240
profile.dividendPolicy: The Company has set a policy to pay dividends at the rate of not less than 50 percent of net profit after corporate income tax and after deduction based on the legal reserve and other accumulated funds as specified by the Company. However, the said dividend payment rate may change from the predetermined result depending on the business performance, financial status, liquidity, necessity for investment, business expansion plans, and other factors related to management as the Board of Directors and/or shareholders of the Company deemed appropriate.
